The [[Aspect of Lazarus]] is an aspect of [[Lazarus the Dire]], kept within [[Justiciar Naveed]] in order to hide the mursaat from the [[Titans]]. Being a part of Lazarus, it's needed for the mursaat's full recovery, but its extraction from Naveed would kill the justiciar. Players meet the aspect as a [[boss]] fought during the [[Insidious Remnants]] [[quest]].

== Locations ==
* [[Tarnished Coast]]
** {{NPC location|Insidious Remnants}} (quest zone)

== Skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Air Attunement}}
* {{Skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{Skill icon|Blinding Surge}} ([[elite]])
* {{Skill icon|Lightning Javelin}}
* {{Skill icon|Lightning Orb}}

== Notes ==
* When the Aspect of Lazarus has no health left, it will vanish - it will not actually "die" and leave a corpse. As a result, players cannot [[Signet of Capture|capture]] Blinding Surge or any other skills from it.
* Unlike most Mursaat, it does not use the skill [[Spectral Agony]].

== Trivia ==
* Like Lazarus the Dire, its name may be a reference to the biblical Lazarus, whom Jesus raised from the dead.
